summary: Isolate singleflight locks between independent cache databases

delivery.outcome: Allow independent project cache databases and distinct namespace/key pairs to load concurrently while preserving singleflight for the same stored record. Publish through protected local verification and independent approval.
nonGoals: No persisted cache identity, database schema, TTL, provider policy, API, dependency or credential changes.
Do not change protected validation/review policy or bypass unavailable required review.

architecture.decision: Scope ephemeral thread locks to the resolved SQLite database path plus an unambiguous namespace/key identity. Retain canonical SQLite flights and all persisted response keys; independent cache stores must not block each other behind an unrelated loader.
architecture.rollback: Protected source revert; cached data and SQLite schema remain compatible.

validation.evidence: Event-coordinated different-database and namespace/key collision regressions, same-database coalescing, supported Python 3.10/3.13 tests and protected exact-head publication.
